title: %maxOf — maximum of scalar arguments
purpose: Return the largest of two or more scalar numeric arguments.
notes: Variadic: pass each operand as a separate scalar argument.
This is not an array-reducing verb — to take the maximum of an array, fan its elements out as individual references.

avoid.why: %maxOf compares its scalar arguments; passing a single array reference coerces the array to its length, not its maximum element
